research_question: Ground raw language into a frozen opaque typed semantic inventory without testing vocabulary invention.

visible_input_contract.entity_registry: neutral entity IDs and types; entity identity resolution is in scope but open-ended entity discovery is not
visible_input_contract.opaque_semantic_inventory: predicate IDs such as P01 with only type signature/arity, never natural-language glosses
visible_input_contract.frozen_demonstrations: raw-language examples paired with typed IR, identical for both arms

arguments: visible entity IDs in semantic argument order

output_rules: When status=AMBIGUOUS, atoms must be empty.
When status=OK, every predicate must exist in the visible opaque inventory.
Argument count/types must satisfy the visible predicate signature.
Duplicate atoms collapse under canonical set semantics.
Surface wording or hidden natural-language predicate names are never emitted or scored.
Both deterministic and Qwen arms have identical output authority.

primary_metrics.semantic_slot_accuracy: Jaccard over canonical (predicate,polarity,modality) slot set; 1.0 for equal empty sets only on correctly ambiguous fixtures
primary_metrics.exact_typed_ir_rate: exact status plus exact canonical atom set including argument order, polarity and modality

secondary_metrics.argument_binding_accuracy: fraction of gold atoms whose predicate/polarity/modality matched and whose ordered arguments exactly match
secondary_metrics.type_arity_valid_rate: fraction of emitted atoms valid under visible signatures and entity types
secondary_metrics.relation_direction_accuracy: for multi-argument gold atoms with correct predicate/polarity/modality and same entity multiset, fraction with correct argument order
secondary_metrics.negation_modality_accuracy: for gold predicate+argument matches, fraction with exact polarity and modality
secondary_metrics.abstention_accuracy: fixture-level correctness of AMBIGUOUS vs OK status

scoring_prohibitions: No use of downstream result to rewrite the upstream gold IR.
